constraints_found.source_line: brooke: "poll's closed, dinner crew! curry 3, 'surprise me' 1"

constraints_found.constraint: Budget: $ (street-cart prices); $$ is one tier over and costs a star
constraints_found.source_line: maya: "street-cart prices, please. one step up from that and i'm counting coins the whole walk home"

constraints_found.constraint: Fresh, light, not fried/heavy food (pre-race fuel)
constraints_found.source_line: brooke: "so tonight i need fuel, not a food coma. fresh and clean, please"

constraints_found.constraint: Mina is vegetarian (strict diet) and wants a venue where she can order freely, i.e. plenty of meat-free options
constraints_found.source_line: maya: "...cyrus slid that menu over with a whole page of meat-free picks..." / mina: "pointing at anything on the board without asking a single question... i'd love that again tonight :)"

constraints_found.constraint: Roxy is dairy intolerant (no cream, yogurt or butter in the sauce); intolerance, costs a star
constraints_found.source_line: roxy: "i stole one sip of my roommate's iced latte last night and regretted it until 2am" / brooke: "a lot of curries are made with cream, yogurt or butter" / roxy: "...oh. ok, none of that in my sauce."

venue_assessment.night_market_marigold_cart: Curry, $, nothing fried, fresh herbs, 3 of 4 pots vegetarian with a separate ladle, coconut milk/coconut oil base with no dairy. Meets everything: 3 stars.
venue_assessment.night_market_night_heron: Curry, $, lean, no fryer, over half vegetarian, but ghee and yogurt in every pot (dairy). Misses Roxy: 2 stars.
venue_assessment.night_market_lucky_seven: Curry, $, half vegetarian, dairy-free, but everything is fried and greasy. Misses Brooke: 2 stars.
venue_assessment.night_market_firefly_lane: $, vegetarian-friendly, dairy-free, fresh, but Vietnamese, not curry. Misses the craving: 2 stars.
venue_assessment.night_market_tall_grass: Curry, vegetarian-friendly, dairy-free, steamed/simmered, but $$ (one tier over budget): 2 stars.
venue_assessment.night_market_glass_bead: Curry, $, light, dairy-free, but no vegetarian option at all (shrimp paste, chicken stock). Deal-breaker for Mina: 0 stars.

notes: Good design: every decoy fails exactly one constraint, so the player must catch all five to land on Marigold Cart.

Mina's vegetarianism is never stated outright; it is inferred from Maya's sushi-day memory ('a whole page of meat-free picks'). Fair for a late level, but it is the most buried clue. Glass Bead is the only venue it rules out, so missing it would still usually land on a good pick.
Roxy's dairy clue is clear thanks to Brooke spelling out cream/yogurt/butter.

Maya's budget line ('one step up from that and i'm counting coins') reads as a soft penalty for $$, which matches the one-star rule. Tall Grass's review also says 'a few dollars more', consistent with its $$ card.

Minor ambiguity: Marigold Cart serves one fish curry. If Mina's 'pointing at anything on the board' is read as needing a 100% vegetarian menu, Marigold would miss it, but then no curry venue qualifies; the separate ladle detail makes Marigold read as the intended answer.
Night Heron's dairy is spelled out heavily (ghee and yogurt in every pot), which makes it a fair but slightly obvious trap.
